name: Dong Hoi to Phong Nha
summary: The park puts Phong Nha Cave 50 km southeast of Đồng Hới. The ward page says about 50 km and does not name the compass point. Minutes, a taxi fare, and a local bus are check on arrival.

modes.note: Print both distances: 50 km southeast on the park’s page, and about 50 km on the ward page. No minute count was printed. Cave tickets and boat prices stay on the park page. A tour card that marks the caves free disagrees with the park and is not used here.

seoTitle: Dong Hoi to Phong Nha — 50 km, minutes on arrival
seoDescription: Phong Nha Cave is 50 km southeast of Dong Hoi on the park page. The ward page says about 50 km. The minutes, a taxi fare, and a local bus are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Should you sleep in Dong Hoi or in the village?
faqs.a: Sleep in Dong Hoi when the beach night is the point. Sleep in Phong Nha village when the boat cave is the trip. The park does not print the minutes from the city, so do not treat the cave as a stop before a flight.
